Name: Saurianne's Sweet Shetland Ponies
Author: saurianne
Description:
UPDATE 1.1. PLEASE DELETE OLD FILES AND GET RID OF ANY MINER'S LETTUCE YOU HAVE, IT IS NO LONGER SUPPORTED BY THE NEW VERSION.

A new barn animal, the Shetland Pony! This is my first-ever mod and I have no idea what I'm doing but I hope you enjoy the tiny horses anyway.

Ponies forage two new items, Horsetail and Mustang Mint. Leah, Linus, George and Caroline love Horsetail; Leah, Caroline, Jas, and Gus love Mustang Mint.

Update 2.0: the ponies are finally up and running for 1.6! They've got a new look and 12 skins to choose from: Sorrel, Palomino, Buckskin, Mushroom, Black, and Blue Roan, in solid and paint varieties. However, it seems that once again the game no longer informs you of which skin you're getting upon purchase. I don't know how to fix it, so for now you'll all just have to be surprised.

Also, Horsetail and Mustang Mint can now be placed in a keg to make teas.
